articles.headline: FICO FY 3Q'26: Welcome to 'Gaming'
articles.summary: MBI's fiscal Q3 2026 earnings deep-dive on FICO covers a quarter where revenue grew +26% YoY but missed consensus, triggering a ~24% stock decline that signals something beyond a routine miss. The 'Gaming' framing points to structural concerns around FICO Score manipulation by consumers or lenders — undermining the predictive value of the score itself — alongside competitive and regulatory pressure on FICO's pricing power. MBI unpacks the financial model context and whether this represents a durable re-rating or an overreaction.
articles.why_it_matters: FICO's monopoly moat in credit scoring is one of the most defensible in financial infrastructure, so a 24% drop demands serious diligence on whether the 'gaming' dynamic is a temporary noise or a secular erosion of the score's utility and FICO's pricing leverage.

articles.headline: Bayer's Sai Jasti on Driving Productivity in R&D with Data Science and AI
articles.summary: Sai Jasti, Bayer's SVP and Head of Data Science and AI, details how Bayer has spent four-plus years transitioning from opportunistic AI experimentation to a committed, AI-first R&D strategy targeting a 40% productivity improvement by 2030. The interview covers the mindset shift required to embed data science across discovery and clinical workflows, the infrastructure and talent adaptations needed, and how Bayer is uniting technical, scientific, and clinical teams around shared productivity goals. Jasti draws on prior experience at GSK Vaccines and AstraZeneca to contextualize where AI is generating measurable gains versus where it remains aspirational.
articles.why_it_matters: Provides rare practitioner-level insight into how large-cap biopharma is operationalizing AI in R&D — directly relevant to assessing the competitive data/AI moat of BAYN and peers, and evaluating the ROI thesis for healthcare AI vendors and infrastructure players.
